topics.title: Common diseases in humans and their prevention

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the pathogens, symptoms, transmission and diagnosis of typhoid, pneumonia and the common cold.
Describe the life cycle of Plasmodium in its two hosts and explain the cause of malarial fever.
Relate amoebiasis, ascariasis, filariasis and ringworm to their pathogens and to measures of hygiene and vector control.
Classify the physical, physiological, cellular and cytokine barriers of innate immunity.
Distinguish the primary and secondary immune responses on the basis of immunological memory.
Describe the H2L2 structure of antibodies and distinguish humoral from cell-mediated immunity.
Distinguish active from passive immunity with natural and artificial examples.
Explain how vaccines and antitoxins protect the body, using the memory of the immune system.
State how recombinant DNA technology is used to produce vaccines such as the hepatitis B vaccine.

topics.title: Allergies, auto-immunity and the lymphoid organs

concepts.learning_objective: Explain allergy as an exaggerated IgE response with histamine release from mast cells.
Explain auto-immune disease as an immune attack on self-cells, with an example.
Distinguish primary from secondary lymphoid organs and state their roles.
Identify the routes by which HIV is transmitted and the ways by which it is not.
Explain how HIV replicates in macrophages and helper T-lymphocytes and causes immunodeficiency.
State the diagnosis, treatment limits and preventive measures for AIDS.
Distinguish cancer cells from normal cells and benign from malignant tumors, and explain metastasis.
Classify physical, chemical and biological carcinogens and explain the role of oncogenes.
Describe methods of detecting and treating cancer, including biological response modifiers.
Relate opioids, cannabinoids and coca alkaloids to their sources, receptors and effects.
Explain the physiological effects and health risks of nicotine and tobacco smoke.

topics.title: Adolescence, addiction and prevention of drug abuse

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish addiction from dependence and explain the role of tolerance.
Describe the short-term and long-term effects of drug, alcohol and steroid abuse.
Suggest measures for preventing and controlling drug and alcohol abuse among adolescents.
